operatingPrinciple: No page, article, CTA, internal link or optimization is published unless it maps to a segment, intent, keyword cluster, conversion event and review rule in this model.

dataState.ga4: G-Q5M5LW282F installed; awaiting initial visitor data

marketPriorities.why: High search demand for industrial wire brushes, power-tool accessories and MRO supply; buyers expect clear fitment and fast technical response.
marketPriorities.proofNeeded: Imperial and metric mounting options, machine compatibility, response SLA.

marketPriorities.why: Engineering-led sourcing and emphasis on material traceability, documentation and application-specific capability.
marketPriorities.proofNeeded: Material statements, drawing control, inspection plan, destination-specific compliance review.

marketPriorities.why: Maintenance, fabrication and infrastructure supply routes reward export-ready packing and dependable distributor support.
marketPriorities.proofNeeded: Corrosion-aware material options, carton / pallet configuration, distributor enquiry path.

personas.name: OEM / process engineer
personas.job: Specify or validate a brush for a production machine or finished equipment.
painPoints: A catalog size does not prove fit or safe performance.
Existing brush wears unevenly or leaves inconsistent finish.
Needs a supplier who can read drawings and communicate technical trade-offs.
personas.conversion: Technical RFQ with workpiece, RPM and drawing or photo

personas.name: Industrial distributor / importer
personas.job: Add a reliable brush range or source a private-label / custom line.
painPoints: Needs a legible range without commodity-only positioning.
Requires repeatable packing, labels and reorder consistency.
Needs supplier support before making customer promises.

personas.name: MRO, fabrication or maintenance buyer
personas.job: Solve a cleaning, rust removal, deburring or process-maintenance problem.
painPoints: Current tool damages the surface or is too slow.
Unsure whether to use wire, abrasive nylon or a custom profile.
Needs a practical answer before ordering.

valueProposition.core: Industrial brush configurations engineered around the workpiece, machine and required finish.
proofPillars: Material, trim, density and hub customization
valueProposition.claimsGuardrail: Do not publish unverified certifications, production capacity, lead time, safety rating or market-specific compliance claims.

coreTerms: how to choose wire wheel brush
abrasive nylon brush vs wire brush

rules: Every article must target one named persona and one primary search intent.
Every article must link to exactly one best-fit commercial section and name the next decision the reader should make.
Use application photos, machine constraints and material trade-offs; avoid generic supplier promotion.
Refresh articles when GSC exposes impressions with weak CTR, high-conversion query patterns or new question phrases.

events.name: view_product_family
events.meaning: Visitor reaches a product-family card or product section.
events.success: Signals category relevance; compare by family and market.

events.name: generate_rfq
events.meaning: Visitor submits the RFQ form and opens the prepared inquiry email.
events.success: Primary micro-conversion; tag by selected brush family and landing page.

events.name: article_to_rfq
events.meaning: Visitor follows an article CTA to the RFQ section.

events.name: outbound_contact
events.meaning: Visitor uses a verified future email, phone or WhatsApp contact action.
events.success: Primary conversion once contact details are connected.

measurement.cadence: Weekly review; use qualified RFQ signals, landing-page intent and search-query groups before publishing or changing a page.

signalRules.if: GSC query has 100+ impressions / 28 days, average position 8–20 and CTR below 2.5%
signalRules.then: Rewrite title and meta to match the query’s commercial or problem-solving intent; add a concise answer and internal link from the closest page.

signalRules.if: A commercial page has engaged sessions but no generate_rfq event
signalRules.then: Audit proof, technical inputs, contact friction and CTA placement before adding more traffic.

signalRules.if: An article sends visitors to RFQ but article_to_rfq rate is below 1% after 150 engaged views
signalRules.then: Improve the application checklist, add a decision table and tighten the commercial next step.

signalRules.if: A query converts through an RFQ or qualified lead
signalRules.then: Promote it to a primary term on its mapped intent page; create one supporting application page only if it has distinct buyer need.

signalRules.if: A page earns non-brand impressions but has no entity / evidence clarity
signalRules.then: Add accountable product detail, sourceable material / process information, precise headings and structured data appropriate to the page.
